| `X-Powered-By: PHP/<ver>` | response header | PHP in use; compare `<ver>` to fixed list |
| `Server:` value (Apache/LiteSpeed/nginx) | response header | Host software, not proof of PHP by itself |
| `Set-Cookie: PHPSESSID=` | response header | PHP session in use |
| `Link: <...wp-json/>; rel="https://api.w.org/"` | response header/HTML | WordPress (PHP) |
| `<meta name="generator" content="WordPress ...">` | HTML `<head>` | WordPress (PHP) |
| `/wp-login.php`, `/xmlrpc.php` returning a real login/XML page (200) | path (owner-confirmed sites only) | Live WordPress; a 403/404 alone is not confirmation |
| `_next/static`, `__NEXT_DATA__`, Vercel/Netlify headers | HTML/headers | Static or Node stack, not PHP |
